BiblicalUsage: Charath appears once, and it is the highest use of engraving in the Bible: the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse settles who the author is: the law was not only spoken by God but engraved by Him.
